items: Scan to add
Point your phone camera or a USB scanner at the barcode. Title, author, cover and page count fill themselves in.
Your real bookcases
Tell Stacks you have a Billy or a Kallax, and see every spine on the shelf where it actually sits.
Series and wishlist
Spots the gaps in a series, keeps a shopping list, and tells you in the shop whether you already own it.
Bring your history
Import from Goodreads, StoryGraph and Discogs in a minute. Back up to a file whenever you like.
Track every read
Page progress, a reading timer, daily streaks, half-star ratings and reviews.
Goals and badges
Set “24 books this year” and see if you’re on track. Earn badges along the way.
What to read next
An Up next queue, mood and pace filters, and picks based on the books you loved.
Your year in books
Quotes, notes and a shareable wrap-up of your reading year.
A crate that knows itself
Vinyl and CDs by barcode, with track lists, pressing details and Goldmine grades.
Log every spin
Press ▶ when the needle drops. See your most played, what’s gathering dust, and your year in music.
What it’s worth
Collection value from Discogs prices, plus a stylus tracker that tells you when to replace it.
Find your next record
New albums from artists you spin, similar artists, and a wantlist.
A profile that’s yours
Your top 4 books and records, what you’re reading and what’s spinning, in your colors.
A feed of what friends read
See when friends start, finish or rate a book, and like it.
Buddy reads
Read a book together, see each other’s page, and chat without spoilers.
Lend and borrow
Browse a friend’s shelves, ask to borrow, and never forget who has your copy.
